claim: Free open-source streaming solution that turns a personal collection into a web listening experience
Playlists, smart playlists, scrobbling, podcasts, radio, Last.fm/Spotify/MusicBrainz integrations
Koel Plus adds multi-user libraries, collaboration, SSO, cloud storage drivers, custom themes, white-labeling
Koel Player is the official iOS and Android app, in a separate repository
Requires PHP >= 8.2; tested with MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite
Five install methods; standalone FrankenPHP archive uses SQLite by default and needs no Composer, Node or system PHP
Building from source needs Composer, Git, Node.js >= 20 with pnpm
Koel scans a personal music library; no licensed catalogue is described
